prompts.name: kubectl-edit-stopgap
prompts.prompt: Someone kubectl edit'd the replica count on app-a-api in prod from 3 to 6 yesterday during a traffic spike. Now ConfigHub still says 3. How do I reconcile?

prompts.name: sidecar-injection-annotations
prompts.prompt: Linkerd was just installed and it's injecting sidecar annotations into all my Deployments. ConfigHub now shows drift on every Unit. What's the right move?

prompts.name: bulk-drift-after-incident
prompts.prompt: We had a prod incident last night and SRE made a bunch of manual cluster edits to stabilize things. Now ~20 Units across app-a and app-b show LiveRevisionNum != LastAppliedRevisionNum. Help us reconcile without losing the incident fixes.
